name: ledger-narrow-gap
description: Ledgers beside a window that leaves little room (#199) and the List's hover ledger scrolled by the wheel (#200). A ledger whose gap beside the window is narrower than 72 GUI px (Ledger_Neptune.MIN_OPEN_WIDTH, the gap a 176 px window leaves on a 320 px screen) opens at 72 px (or its natural width when shorter) over the window, clamped to the screen, drawn above the slots, with the mouse and the keys unable to reach what it covers; with room it sits beside the window exactly as before. Screens and the numbers behind the clicks: 854x480 at GUI scale 2 is a 427x240 screen (125 px each side of a 176 px window); 640x480 is 320x240, the narrowest screen vanilla allows and, on Windows, the narrowest a window can be (72 px beside a 176 px window, 32 beside the Builder's 256, 38 beside the Library's 244). Ledger tabs are not vanilla widgets, so they are clicked by position: closed tabs are 22x24, stacked 29 apart from topPos + 5, left of the window (centre leftPos - 11) or right of it (centre leftPos + width + 11); the runner deletes gui_state.json before each boot so every ledger starts closed. The List keeps its settings on the held item, so its steps run together.

steps.label: window 854x480 (a 427x240 GUI screen at scale 2: 125 px each side of a 176 px window)
creative, floor, a Builder, a Library and a Stone Engine in a row; a pickaxe in the first inventory slot, an axe in the last of its row
run: item replace entity @p container.9 with minecraft:diamond_pickaxe
item replace entity @p container.17 with minecraft:diamond_axe

steps.label: REGRESSION on a wide screen: the engine's ledgers sit beside the window at their natural width
open the Stone Engine
open the power ledger first (right tab, second: an open ledger above it would push its tab down)
open the owner ledger (right tab, first)

steps.name: e1-engine-wide
steps.look: Both right-side ledgers are open beside the window, at the width their text needs (the owner ledger is not stretched, nothing overlaps the window), every line readable, nothing cut off. Their left edges line up with the window's right edge.

steps.label: pick the pickaxe up from the first inventory slot
carry it over the open owner ledger

steps.name: e2-carried-over-ledger
steps.look: REGRESSION, z-order: the pickaxe the cursor carries is drawn ON TOP of the open owner ledger and its text (it is not hidden under the panel), exactly as before the covering pass existed. The ledger itself is beside the window.

steps.label: put the pickaxe back
close the owner ledger
close the power ledger
#200: a List; the pickaxe becomes the exemplar of line 0
open the List
pick the pickaxe up
set it as line 0's exemplar
put it back in the inventory slot
line 0: By Type
line 0: By Material
open the match ledger (left tab, first)
mouse over line 0's first slot

steps.name: d1-list-hover-top
steps.look: The match ledger is open on the left of the window with the By Type and By Material tag lists for the pickaxe, as tall as the screen, beside the window (not over it). Its first lines are the title and 'By Type'; a scroll bar runs along its right inner edge (the content is taller than the panel). The first slot of line 0 shows the pickaxe.

steps.label: wheel down over the slot, 4 notches

steps.name: d2-list-hover-scrolled
steps.look: Same hover, same ledger: its text has MOVED UP by about 12 lines compared with d1 (the title is gone, later tag lines are in view) and the scroll bar thumb has moved down. The ledger did not fall back to its idle text.

steps.label: wheel down to the end

steps.name: d3-list-hover-bottom
steps.look: The last lines of the ledger (the final tag entries) are in view with the scroll bar thumb at the bottom. No text is cut off at the bottom edge of the panel.

steps.label: wheel back up over the slot

steps.name: d4-list-hover-top-again
steps.look: Back at the top: the title and 'By Type' are in view again, as in d1.

steps.label: close the List

window 640x480 (a 320x240 GUI screen at scale 2): 72 px each side of a 176 px window, 32 px beside the Builder's 256, 38 beside the Library's 244. Windows below 320 px wide are not possible on Windows, so this is the narrowest screen there is
REGRESSION at the gap exactly a standard window leaves on the smallest screen: 72 px; the engine's ledgers do not move over the window
power ledger (right tab, second; at 72 px its text wraps into a column as tall as the screen, so the owner ledger stays closed: an open power ledger sits over the owner's tab)
help ledger (left tab, first)

steps.name: e3-engine-72
steps.look: The power ledger (right, 72 px wide, a tall narrow column with a scroll bar) and the help ledger (left) are open and sit BESIDE the window, neither extends over it: the right one starts exactly at the window's right edge, the left one ends exactly at its left edge. The window's slots are fully visible. The owner ledger is a closed tab.

steps.label: close the power ledger
close the help ledger

steps.label: hover the snapshot slot: its help text appears in the ledger

steps.label: move onto the ledger where it covers the first resource slot: the text stays the snapshot's, the resource area is not highlighted over the panel

steps.name: a3-builder-help-on-panel
steps.look: The ledger still shows the SNAPSHOT help text from a2 (it was not retargeted to the resources help by the mouse resting on the part of the panel that lies over the resources area) and no highlight border or tint is painted over the panel; the snapshot slot's highlight border is still drawn (selected). The slot under the pointer shows no hover highlight or tooltip.

steps.label: the wheel over the ledger scrolls it

steps.name: a4-builder-help-scrolled
steps.look: The ledger text moved up compared with a3 and is still the snapshot help.

the axe is gone from that slot: it was thrown

steps.label: clear the thrown axe

steps.label: KEYS over a COVERED slot: Q with the mouse on the ledger, over the first inventory slot (the pickaxe), drops nothing
the pickaxe is still in that slot

execute if items entity @p hotbar.0 minecraft:diamond_axe

steps.label: state dump for the report: inventory slot 9

The ledger shows the SAME text as in d6 (resting on the panel over the slot did not retarget it), no slot highlight and no item tooltip of the slot under the ledger shows through, the hotbar's first slot holds the axe (the control's swap) and the pickaxe is still where it was (hidden under the ledger).
